description: The answer to the message the user sends after stopping a turn in copilot-stop-journey.spec.ts. That message carries this script's marker, so the scripted model answers it on this script's first turn whether the platform resumes the stopped conversation or passes it on as text.
title: After a Stop

turns.expect_user_text: Forget that. Just give me the short version.
turns.text: Sure. In short, the garden grew well, fed the whole street and is now resting until spring.
